news.title:
Indian stock market is highly volatile, with TCS, HCL Tech, and Birlasoft entering oversold zones (RSI <30).
Key question arises: Will buying resume at these levels or will the pressure intensify further?

Birlasoft hits a 52-week low of Rs 320.15 on May 13, 2026.
The stock faced five consecutive losses, indicating a sustained downtrend.
Now 24% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 10% to ₹345. The fair value is estimated to be ₹277, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 2.9% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 6.3%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 5.4% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 13% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: BSOFT: Leadership Reshuffle And Steady Outlook Will Support Future Repricing
news.body: Analysts have left Birlasoft's fair value estimate unchanged at ₹434, citing only mild tweaks to underlying assumptions such as a slightly different discount rate, revenue growth outlook, profit margin expectation, and future P/E input that did not justify a fresh price target move. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on May 6, 2026 to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider recommending a final dividend, if any, for shareholder approval at the next AGM (Key Developments).

news.title: BSOFT: Leadership Transitions Will Support Stronger Margins And Future Share Repricing
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Birlasoft from ₹505 to ₹434, citing updated assumptions that reflect lower revenue growth, a reduced discount rate, a higher profit margin outlook and a recalibrated future P/E multiple. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on May 06, 2026 to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider recommending a final dividend, if any, for shareholder approval at the AGM (Key Developments).

news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹18.54. Revenue: ₹53.7b (flat on FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.18b (flat on FY 2025). Profit margin: 9.6% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 5.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Software industry in India.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.28 (up from ₹4.20 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹13.8b (up 1.2% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.20b (up 2.5% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.7% (up from 8.6% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 3.1%. Revenue is forecast to grow 7.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Software industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 15% per year.

What's in the News Board meeting scheduled on Jan 28, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025 (company filing).
